messages:
alex: Heads up — Acme Financial kickoff today. They want a POC that demos streaming + function calls + structured JSON output. Can SEs drop a minimal Go and Node example that shows tool/function calling over SSE, plus what telemetry we can expose for legal? @maya @chen

maya: On it. Quick q — do they need callback webhooks or server-push via SSE/websocket? Which SDK do they prefer? :thinking:

alex: They prefer server push (SSE) from their Java backend, but for the demo they'd accept a Node/Go sample. Also need answers to security questionnaire around KMS and data residency. Legal expects timeline for SOC2 artifacts.

chen: For the SDK sample, I'll paste a tiny Node SSE example using our streaming SDK. It includes a function call JSON and structured output schema v1.1.

chen: ```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const stream = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse', tools: ['billing', 'search'] })
stream.on('message', (evt) => console.log('evt', evt))
// request a tool call mid-stream
stream.callTool('billing', { invoiceId: 1234 }).then(res => console.log('billing', res))
```

maya: For structured output, use schema: { "type": "object", "properties": { "action": {"type":"string"}, "payload": {"type":"object"} } } and validate on ingest. We can include a small serializer in the sample repo.

maya: Telemetry: we can surface token/time breakdown per-request, per-route, and per-tool in Console. For legal, we can provide a sanitized telemetry export and a short doc describing retention and access controls. Recommend token-sampling @ 1% for the POC to keep logs light. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qnas/ACME-sq-2026 (uploaded by @rebecca)

rebecca: Added answers to the SQ: KMS options = AWS KMS / GCP KMS; BYOK supported on Private; audit logs via our Console with configurable retention. Data residency: EU-only Dedicated or Private. SSO/OIDC and SCIM notes attached.

alex: Pricing & capacity q: they expect ~10k reqs/day with spikes to 5k/min during scheduled batch runs. What's the baseline Dedicated sizing + burst? @chen

chen: For that profile, recommend 2x A10-equivalent pools with autoscale + 100 concurrent streaming sessions. Baseline throughput ~200 req/s steady, burst handled by autoscale to 800 req/s. I'll drop a pricing estimate doc (T-shirt estimate now, exact after infra calc).

maya: Blockers: customer requires audit logs retained 12 months and EU-only KMS. That forces Private (or Dedicated in EU with BYOK). Sales — are we ok to propose Private for POC? @alex

alex: Yes, include Private option in proposal. Proposed POC timeline: 4 weeks — wk1 integration + sample apps, wk2 perf run, wk3 security signoff, wk4 migration/handbook. Who owns the runbook?

maya: I'll own runbook + sample apps. Chen owns perf harness. I'll upload initial sample repo today: https://git.redwood/se/sales/acme-poc

alex: Great. I'll update the deal doc and ping Legal for SOC2 artifacts and contract terms. Also requesting a short one-pager on telemetry exports for their security team. Thanks team :rocket:
